notes: LIVE, actively trading storefront (unlike sibling S.N.193 Pottery Barn UAE which was permanently closed) -- run on the Reliance/Fynd commerce platform (pottery-barn.fynd.io backend), homepage shows live INR pricing and 'Zero-cost EMI available up to 12 months on purchases over INR 40,000' banner, full checkout/cart/wishlist flow present. Direct HTTP GET worked throughout (no WAF); robots.txt disallows '/collections*' (plural) for User-agent:* but no Claude-specific disallow, and all pages fetched here are under '/collection/<slug>' (singular), which robots.txt does not block; Googlebot is fully allowed. Access route: direct fetch of mega-menu (nav) + individual /collection/<slug> pages; qty taken from the site's own rendered 'Hide Filters N items' listing header (matches storefront-count-apis-are-inflated precedent of preferring the rendered header) -- for Ceiling Lights, verified Chandeliers(9)+Pendants(6)=15 exactly matches the parent's own displayed total, confirming the header is an exact per-category count, not a rounded/capped widget. Scope: Furniture, Bedding, Rugs, Bath Linens, Gifts/Holiday, Sale/Clearance, brand Collections, 'Reliance Friends & Family' pages, Cushions & Throws/Cushion Covers, Faux Plants & Botanicals, and cutlery-type Serving Utensils were fully excluded (not emitted as rows). Baskets & Storage (jewelry boxes, seagrass/leather storage baskets, travel cases) was evaluated and excluded as storage/organizational rather than decorative accessory. Cross-tag/orphan pages 'Outdoor Dinnerware' (50 items) and 'Outdoor Serveware' (77 items) were identified as filter-style roll-ups spanning the already-counted Dinnerware/Serveware subcategories (same 'Product Type' facets, not a distinct nav branch, not linked from the mega-menu) -- excluded per NEVER EXTRACT filter-page rule to avoid double counting. Several sitemap URLs proved to be duplicate-content aliases of already-counted categories (Vanity Mirrors == Wall+Floor Mirrors combined, 18=13+5; Soup and Cereal Bowls == Bowls, both 19; Outdoor Botanicals == Outdoor Planters, both 15) -- confirmed via product-type facet match and not double counted. No Clocks category exists anywhere on the site (checked full mega-menu and the collections sitemap for 'clock', zero matches). 3 of 33 leaf rows are null+MANUAL REVIEW (Bar Accessories & Decanters, Placemats & Chargers, Candles) because each is a mixed in-scope/excluded roll-up on a single collection page with no site-side filter to isolate the in-scope subset and an incomplete (non-exhaustive) static title list; Cheese Boards & Knives was resolved to an exact count (3) instead of null because its full 5-item list rendered completely, allowing exhaustive manual title classification.
